name: use-novamira/novamira
_comment: conflict pins these transitive deps to their PHP 8.0-compatible lines: lcobucci/jwt 5.x needs PHP 8.2, lcobucci/clock 3.x needs 8.3, and league/uri 6.8+ needs 8.1. league/oauth2-server 8.5 also supports jwt 4.x / clock 2.x / uri 6.7.x, so excluding the newer lines keeps the plugin installable on PHP 8.0.
